sections.title: Part 1 (from 11 to 15): Read Nick’s email carefully and choose A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct word or phrase. (1.25pts)
sections.introHtml:
To: phong@webmail.com; mi@webmail.com

Subject: A room at the Crazy House Hotel

Hi Phong and Mi,

How are you? I'm in Da Lat with my parents. We're staying at the Crazy House Hotel. Wow! It is really crazy. There are (11) ……… rooms in the hotel. There's a Kangaroo Room, an Eagle Room, and even an Ant Room. I'm (12) ……… in the Tiger Room. It's called the Tiger Room because there's a big tiger (13) ……… the wall. The tiger is (14) ……… the bathroom door and the window. The bed is next to the window, but the window is in a strange shape. I put my bag under the bed. There's a (15) ………, a wardrobe and a desk in my room. You should stay here when you visit Da Lat. It's great.

See you soon!

Nick

sections.title: Part 1 (from 21 to 25) Read the passage and decide if the statements are True (T) or False (F) (1.25pts)
sections.introHtml: My name's Mai. I live in a town house in Ha Noi. I live with my parents. There are six rooms in our house: a living room, a kitchen, two bedrooms, and two bathrooms. I love our living room the best because it's bright. It's next to the kitchen. I have my own bedroom. It's small but beautiful. There's a bed, a desk, a chair, and a bookshelf. It also has a big window and a clock on the wall. I often read books in my bedroom.

sections.title: Part 2 (from 26 to 30): Read the passage and choose the correct answer A, B, C, or D (1.25pts)
sections.introHtml: Hello, my name is Lan. I’m a student. My new school is in a quiet place not far from the city centre. It has three buildings and a large yard. This year there are 26 classes with more than 1000 students at my school. Most students are hard-working and kind. The school has about 40 teachers. They are all helpful and friendly. My school has 5 clubs: Dance, English, Arts, Football and Basketball. I like English, so I am in the English club. I love my school because it is a good school.

questions.html:
26. Is Lan a student?

A. Yes, they are. B. Yes, she is.

C. She is a teacher. D. No, she isn’t.

27. How many buildings does her school have?

A. There is one building. B. There is a building.

C. There are 26 buildings. D. There are 3 buildings.

28. What are most students like?

A. They are lovely and friendly. B. They are helpful and friendly.

C. They are hard-working and kind. D. They are caring and kind.

29. Does her school have 5 clubs?

A. She likes English. B. No, she doesn’t.

C. Yes, it does. D. No, it doesn’t.

30. Why does she love her school?

A. Because her school has about 40 teachers. B. Because her school is good.

C. Because it has more than 1000 students. D. Because she is in the English club.

37. Write a paragraph about your best friend (40 - 60 words) (1.0pt)

You might use the following questions below:

1. What’s her/his name?

2. What does she/he look like?

3. What’s she/he like?

4. Why do you like him/her?

The end
